citations.description: Reddit discussions on r/OnlyMurdersHulu highlight 'Only Murders in the Building' as a top Hulu show, with fans praising its Season 4 plot twists and star-studded cast.
The Hollywood Reporter covers 'The Bear' and 'Only Murders in the Building' as Emmy-nominated Hulu originals, noting their critical acclaim and streaming popularity.
Rotten Tomatoes ranks 'Shogun' and 'Mufasa: The Lion King' highly, with 'Shogun' noted as FX’s most-viewed premiere and 'Mufasa' receiving mixed reviews for its visuals.
Filmfare reports 'Abbott Elementary' and 'Shogun' winning big at the 2025 SAG Awards, emphasizing their ensemble casts and Hulu’s strong comedy and drama lineup.
IMDb reviews praise 'Mufasa: The Lion King' for its animation and cast, while 'Only Murders in the Building' is celebrated for its award-nominated performances.
